Training weights and hidden-map metrics replay exactly; all 27,522 model predictions obey the exact observation bounds. The frozen hard-observation validation Brier lower bound is 0.47574, and only 15.66% of events are mutable through unknown completion. The manuscript remains a working draft. Both physical tests remain locked; no successful transfer or final-paper claim is supported. Clean no-event/no-global three-seed training ablations are now complete: Brier 0.20425 +/- 0.00322 and 0.09499 +/- 0.00157 versus full 0.06749 +/- 0.00936. All six descriptive paired Brier scene intervals are positive; all six equal-30%-coverage risk intervals include zero. No-event radius-20 predictions are all zero despite positive prevalence 20.67%. This completes the bounded-validation internal ablation, not the planned external main comparisons or final test.
